primary_estimand: Incremental held-out future functional prediction from patchwise co-location of effective interaction and trait/genetic state above aligned marginals

records.documented_grain: 4 experimental populations (2 spatial layouts x 2 separate seasonal runs), individual flowering/position/genotype and offspring paternity, site-date-batch visitation counts
records.evidence: Dryad published README: 854 pollen donors, 180 gene traps, 1970 offspring; 10 microsatellite loci; 7+8 gene-trap batches in one reproductive season; visitation counts are Site x DOY/Date x Batch, not donor-patch matched
records.novelty_boundary: 2026 Evolution paper already tested longitudinal versus cross-sectional selection and spatial arrangement effects

records.documented_grain: 13 populations with population-mean visitation, effective size, histological pollen limitation and reproductive output; collections in 2019-2021
records.evidence: Dryad README lists Pollinator_data_inputR2.xlsx, polpist_final2019-2021.xlsx, pop_level_dataset.xlsx and within-population mean variables; 3-year span is not proof of forward joined cohort
records.secondary_route: EXISTING_INTERACTION_X_GENETIC_FUNCTION_PRIOR_ART; do not frame I x Ne as novel
records.novelty_boundary: Genetic effective population size × pollinator visitation and reproductive output interaction already published

records.documented_grain: 19 maternal plants, 1323 offspring genotyped at 8 microsatellites, two reproductive years, local flowering density
records.evidence: Dryad archive lists Camellia_japonica_Data.xlsx; bird pollinator foraging response inferred from density and pollen pool diversity, not direct matched patchwise visitation
records.novelty_boundary: Density-mediated bird foraging and pollen-pool compensation already proposed

records.documented_grain: per-taxon bee visitation/pollen removal, restricted donor visitation, paternity-assigned offspring and siring success
records.evidence: College of Wooster public analysis archive lists SiringSuccessData.csv, PollenRemovalData.csv, PollenToSeed data and README; publication explicitly tests visitation proxy versus male fitness
records.novelty_boundary: Pollinator taxon impacts on male fitness and proxy mismatch are already tested in the 2023 study

records.documented_grain: 2019 paper sampled fruit/seed set and germination in 12 remnants; 2026 archive has adult/seedling microsatellites and paternity files
records.evidence: Two independently archived study packages; same species and fragmentation theme do not establish matched plants/population-years or prospective joined outcomes
records.novelty_boundary: Fragmentation linked reproductive success and gene flow are separate established findings
